sentences.en: Do you believe that rigid bureaucracies are controlling the world?
sentences.zh: 你相信是那些僵化的官僚机构在掌控世界吗？

sentences.en: There was so much paperwork and bureaucracy I just gave up.
sentences.zh: 文件堆积如山，官僚程序繁琐得让我放弃了。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to reduce bureaucracy to attract foreign investments.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要减少官僚主义以吸引外国投资。

senses.zh: 官僚制度，官僚机构，官僚作风；官僚，政府官员
